title: Policy checklist screening
summary: Check a draft against an explicit local publishing rule.
why: A publishing workflow needs a policy flag, not a general compliance essay.

violation.instructions: Does draft promise a guaranteed investment return? Policy prohibits guaranteed-return claims.

state.draft: Invest here and you are guaranteed to double your money.

limitation: Checks one fictional publishing rule. It does not determine legal or regulatory compliance.
